items.source: You can customize the listener registrar by implementing the RedisListenerConfigurer interface. See the javadoc of classes that implement RedisListenerConfigurer for details and examples.
items.translation: 您可以通过实现 RedisListenerConfigurer 接口来自定义 listener registrar。有关详细信息和示例，请参阅实现了 RedisListenerConfigurer 的类的 JavaDoc。

items.source: The idea of the preceding example is that, whenever a message is received through a channel my-channel, the processOrder method is invoked accordingly (in this case, with the content of the Redis Pub/Sub message, similar to what the MessageListenerAdapter provides).
items.translation: 前一个示例的核心思想是：每当通过通道 `my-channel` 接收到消息时，就会相应地调用 `processOrder` 方法（在本例中，传入的是 Redis Pub/Sub 消息的内容，类似于 `MessageListenerAdapter` 所提供的功能）。

items.source: Handling of method arguments is provided by DefaultMessageHandlerMethodFactory, which you can further customize to support additional method arguments. Annotated-based endpoints support flexible message conversion, which is provided by RedisMessageConverters along with a default set of converters for String, byte array, and JSON (if a supported library is present on the classpath). If you wish to customize the message conversion, you can do so by implementing RedisListenerConfigurer and overriding the configureMessageConverters method, as the following example shows:
items.translation: 方法参数的处理由 `DefaultMessageHandlerMethodFactory` 提供，您可以进一步自定义它以支持额外的方法参数。 基于注解的端点支持灵活的消息转换，该功能由 `RedisMessageConverters` 提供，并包含针对 String、字节数组和 JSON（如果类路径中存在支持的库）的默认转换器集。 如果您希望自定义消息转换，可以通过实现 `RedisListenerConfigurer` 并重写 `configureMessageConverters` 方法来实现，如下例所示：

items.source: The annotated endpoint infrastructure creates a message listener behind the scenes for each annotated method and registering to RedisMessageListenerContainer. Endpoints are not registered against the application context but can be easily located for management purposes by using the RedisListenerEndpointRegistry bean.
items.translation: 注解端点基础设施会在后台为每个注解的方法创建消息监听器，并将其注册到RedisMessageListenerContainer。 这些端点并未注册到应用程序上下文中，但可以通过RedisListenerEndpointRegistry Bean 轻松定位它们以进行管理。

items.source: RedisListenerEndpoint provides a model of a Redis endpoint and is responsible for configuring the container for that model. The infrastructure lets you programmatically configure endpoints in addition to the ones that are detected by the RedisListener annotation. The following example shows how to do so:
items.translation: RedisListenerEndpoint 提供了 Redis 端点的模型，并负责为该模型配置容器。 基础设施允许您通过编程方式配置端点，而不仅限于由 RedisListener 注解检测到的端点。 以下示例展示了如何实现这一点：

items.source: In the preceding example, we used SimpleRedisListenerEndpoint, which provides the actual MessageListener to invoke. However, you could also build your own endpoint variant to describe a custom invocation mechanism.
items.translation: 在前面的示例中，我们使用了 `SimpleRedisListenerEndpoint`，它提供了实际用于调用的 `MessageListener`。 不过，您也可以构建自己的端点变体来描述自定义的调用机制。

items.source: Note that you could skip the use of @RedisListener altogether and programmatically register only your endpoints through RedisListenerConfigurer.
items.translation: 请注意，您可以完全跳过使用 `@RedisListener` 注解，而仅通过 `RedisListenerConfigurer` 以编程方式注册您的端点。

items.source: The org.springframework.messaging.Message that represents the incoming Redis message. Note that this message holds headers (as defined by PubSubHeaders).
items.translation: 代表传入 Redis 消息的org.springframework.messaging.Message。 请注意，该消息包含标题（由PubSubHeaders定义）。

items.source: A @Headers-annotated argument that must also be assignable to java.util.Map for getting access to all headers.
items.translation: 一个带有 `@Headers` 注解的参数，该参数还必须可赋值给 `java.util.Map` 以获取所有标头。

items.source: A non-annotated element that is not one of the supported types is considered to be the payload. You can make that explicit by annotating the parameter with @Payload. You can also turn on validation by adding an extra @Valid.
items.translation: 非注解且不属于支持类型的元素被视为有效载荷。您可以通过使用 @Payload 注解该参数来明确这一点。此外，通过添加额外的 @Valid 还可以启用验证。

The next example shows converter selection for the JdkSerializationRedisSerializer converter assuming a registration as per the previous example:
items.translation: @RedisListener(consumes) 可用于在使用不同的消息转换器时指定期望的内容类型，以便选择适当的转换器。 下一个示例展示了针对 JdkSerializationRedisSerializer 转换器的转换器选择过程，假设其注册方式与前面的示例一致：

items.source: If you require more control over the method argument resolution, you can also configure a custom MessageHandlerMethodFactory through RedisListenerConfigurer. You can customize the conversion and validation support there as well.
items.translation: 如果您需要更精细地控制方法参数解析，也可以通过 RedisListenerConfigurer 配置自定义的 MessageHandlerMethodFactory。 您还可以在此处自定义转换和验证支持。

items.source: @Header-annotated method arguments to extract a specific header value. Since Redis Pub/Sub messages do consist only of the body, header values such as the topic or pattern that matched the message are synthetically added as headers.
items.translation: 使用 @Header 注解的方法参数来提取特定的标头值。由于 Redis 发布/订阅消息仅包含正文，因此匹配该消息的主题或模式等标头值是作为标头合成添加的。

items.source: RedisMessageConverters uses Spring Data Redis’s RedisSerializers` for JSON serialization. Its JSON serialization format and behavior might slightly differ from Spring Messaging’s JacksonJsonMessageConverter. If you wish to use Spring Messaging’s variant then configure the desired converter through Builder.addCustomConverter(MessageConverter).
items.translation: RedisMessageConverters 使用 Spring Data Redis 的 RedisSerializers 进行 JSON 序列化。其 JSON 序列化格式和行为可能与 Spring Messaging 的 JacksonJsonMessageConverter 略有不同。如果您希望使用 Spring Messaging 的版本，则可以通过 Builder.addCustomConverter(MessageConverter) 配置所需的转换器。

items.source: @RedisListener is a repeatable annotation, so you can associate several Redis topics (channels or patterns) with the same method by adding additional @RedisListener declarations to it.
items.translation: @RedisListener 是一个可重复注解，因此您可以通过向其添加额外的 @RedisListener 声明，将多个 Redis 主题（频道或模式）关联到同一个方法上。

items.source: Payload argument conversion for annotated endpoints that do not specify a content type will be processed by the first converter that can read the message payload.
items.translation: 对于未指定内容类型的注解端点，其载荷参数的转换将由第一个能够读取消息载荷的转换器进行处理。
